g.text: Zephyr architecture: native contracts over one runtime
Z1 · Ordinary single-image model · CONFIG_USERSPACE changes access checks, not this dependency map
Native APIs are the normal surface. Neither a header nor an API call implies a new thread, a process, or a privilege transition.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration
